gap_summaries: [ultrathink] FIXED convergence_gate.py:121 strict mode double-counts duplicates in invalid_ratio — invalid_count already includes duplicates (marked INVALID), adding dup_count again over-subtracts gap counts causing premature convergence
[ultrathink] FIXED convergence_gate.py:40 _load_validation_config crashes with AttributeError when workflow.json has "validation": "invalid_string" instead of dict — .get() on string raises

[ultrathink] gap_validator.py:188 normalize_gap strips ALL path-like strings via re.sub(r'\S+/', '', text) — gaps referencing different files (src/validation/ vs src/orchestrator/) normalize to same text, triggering false duplicate detection

[ultrathink] gap_validator.py:212 check_tool_claims keyword 'test' too broad — gaps about 'testing patterns' or 'test architecture' incorrectly trigger tool cross-check against cached pytest results, potentially invalidating valid architectural observations

[ultrathink] gap_validator.py:260-280 tool cross-check not applied to gaps WITH file references — a gap like 'store.py:45 lint violations' has valid file ref but invalid tool claim; skipping cross-check marks it valid when lint actually passed

[ultrathink] state.py clear_phase_state adds 4 new validation artifacts to cleanup but no test verifies .gap-validation.json, .spec-compliance.json, .feature-verification.json, .quality-gate-results.json are removed

[ultrathink] feature_tester.py:56-57 run_feature_verification silently returns empty results when compliance file missing — no logging or event emission, indistinguishable from 'verified 0 features successfully'

[ultrathink] prompts.py phase_c_prompt receives compliance and verification reports but not gap validation results — Phase C has no visibility into which gaps were invalid, may waste time fixing hallucinated gaps

[ultrathink] test_trust_verify_integration.py TestEndToEndGapValidation.test_full_gap_validation_pipeline uses strict mode but only asserts isinstance(code, int) — doesn't verify invalid gaps actually reduced effective counts
[ultrathink] gap_validator.py:82 _FILE_ONLY regex matches too broadly — 'version 2.py' extracts '2.py' as file reference, could produce false valid state for gaps with accidental matches

[ultrathink] gap_validator.py:158-171 check_symbol_exists performs O(n*m) linear scan of all .py files per symbol — 20 gaps with symbols on 1000-file project = 20000 file reads, may exceed spec's <100ms target
[ultrathink] state.py SKIP_FILES hardcoded as full frozenset — each milestone must list all values, not extend previous set; fragile for future additions
[ultrathink] cli.py validation config has no range validation on spec_compliance_budget and feature_verification_budget — negative values silently passed to run_claude
[ultrathink] spec section 3.6 performance target (<100ms for 20 gaps) has no benchmark test or performance assertion

[ultrathink] telemetry.py new event types GapValidationEvent, SpecComplianceCompleted, FeatureVerificationCompleted not mapped in TelemetryDbWriter — events written to JSONL but silently dropped from PostgreSQL
[ultrathink] orchestrator.py _run_spec_compliance module_dirs detection only checks src/ vs . — doesn't handle monorepo layouts or multiple source directories
[ultrathink] spec_compliance.py build_compliance_prompt embeds file paths without quoting — ambiguous prompt if spec_path or module_dir contains spaces
[ultrathink] DEFERRED: no protection against concurrent convergence hook invocation writing conflicting .gap-validation.json
[ultrathink] DEFERRED: run_claude_fn signature compatibility assumed but only tested via mocks — effort/budget/fallback_model params may not match production run_claude
